intro: Computer Science and Engineering student at UC Merced, focused on security and systems programming.

Coursework across algorithms, computer organization and full-stack development, plus a real-time multiplayer game built on Flask-SocketIO. I work as readily in MIPS assembly and C++ as in Python, and I'm drawn to the gap between how a system is documented and how it actually behaves — the same thing that pulled me toward security.
